eventName.description: The event name for this conversion event. Example: "click"

web_stream_data.description: Data specific to web streams. Required when type is WEB_DATA_STREAM.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name for the Data Stream.

package_name.description: The package name for the app being measured. Example: "com.example.myandroidapp"

android_app_stream_data.description: Data specific to Android app streams. Required when type is ANDROID_APP_DATA_STREAM.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name for the Data Stream.

bundle_id.description: The Apple App Store Bundle ID for the app. Example: "com.example.myiosapp"

ios_app_stream_data.description: Data specific to iOS app streams. Required when type is IOS_APP_DATA_STREAM.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name for the Data Stream.

actions.description: Create a GA4 property under an account.
actions.name: create-property

parent.description: The resource name of the account under which to create the property. Example: "accounts/12345"

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the property. Max 100 UTF-16 code units.

timeZone.description: Reporting time zone for the property. Example: "America/Los_Angeles"

currencyCode.description: Currency type used in reports. Example: "USD"

name.description: Resource name of the created property. Example: "properties/12345"

A Google Analytics property identifier. Example: "properties/1234"

limit.description: The number of rows to return. If unspecified, 10,000 rows are returned.

updateMask.description: The list of fields to be updated. If omitted, it will be computed from provided fields.
